subject: Evaluation MAP: environment handoff & network items
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Sung <alex@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation MAP: environment handoff & network items

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is our draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the evaluation runway and environment handoff items we discussed. High level ask from ClearWave for this phase: a production-like eval in your VPC (peering) + a seeded org with API keys so your engineers can exercise the integration at scale.

Key checklist (short):
- Org seed: one "eval" org plus a separate "prod" org mapping (we can provision both).
- API keys: scoped eval keys, ephemeral dev keys for your CI, rotate guidance attached.
- IP allowlist: we need the CIDR(s) you'll allow from your side for host-to-host callbacks; we can provide a minimal list for egress.
- VPC peering: shared peering runbook and preferred maintenance windows (we prefer early mornings PT).
- Timeline: target eval start = 2027-09-06; cutover/close target = 2027-09-27 (flexible).

Attachments: CW-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with tasks, owners, dates); network-requirements-snippet.txt (short, copyable).

Next steps: can you confirm your network contact and an internal preferred peering window? I can loop in Neha to scope the exact firewall/IP list once we have Jordan's availability.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: CW-MAP-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), network-requirements-snippet.txt (text/plain)

From: Alex Sung <alex@clearwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Park <jordan.park@clearwave.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP: environment handoff & network items

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear list. Jordan (our network lead) is on copy. A few clarifications from our side:

- We prefer a VPC peering approach (private routing) rather than public IPs for this eval; peering is our security team's default.
- Preferred peering window: 2027-08-31 02:00-05:00 PT (low traffic). If that's a problem we can move to 2027-09-02 early-morning.
- For the IP allowlist: Jordan will share our egress NAT ranges; we need the exact set of Redwood endpoints to whitelist for webhook callbacks.
- Timeline: evaluated internally and the team is aiming for the eval start you suggested (2027-09-06). Procurement asked for a short MSA addendum covering data residency and retention for the eval — can your legal contact provide a one-page addendum?

I'll attach a short PDF with our network contact info. Jordan — can you confirm the NAT ranges and whether we need a transit config?

Best,
Alex
Director, Product Integrations — ClearWave Health
alex@clearwave.com

Attachments: clearwave-network-contacts.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Sung <alex@clearwave.com>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@clearwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP: environment handoff & network items

Thanks Alex — looping in the technical notes you requested. Quoted below for context.

On Tue, Aug 24, 2027 at 9:03 AM Alex Sung <alex@clearwave.com> wrote:
> Jordan (our network lead) is on copy. A few clarifications from our side:
> - We prefer a VPC peering approach (private routing) rather than public IPs for this eval; peering is our security team's default.
> - Preferred peering window: 2027-08-31 02:00-05:00 PT (low traffic).

Neha here (Solutions Engineering). Quick technical checklist so your network team can map to our requirements:

- Peering model: AWS-to-AWS VPC peering is supported. We will provide the Redwood peer VPC ID and the minimal route table updates. No transit gateway required for the eval unless you have cross-account routing needs.
- CIDR / IPs: For callbacks/webhooks we typically provide a small set of ephemeral egress ranges (we'll provide 5 IPs for the eval window). If you must whitelist CIDRs, we can provide a /29 for short-term.
- DNS: we recommend using private hosted zones if you need hostname-based routing between VPCs; otherwise direct IP routing is fine.
- API keys: we'll create scoped eval keys limited to the evaluation org; recommended lifecycle: issue -> test -> rotate after 14 days. We support secret rotation via API and can set up one-time ephemeral tokens for CI.
- Testing: pre-peering smoke tests (ping, route verification, TLS handshake) — I can run these with Jordan during the maintenance window.

Action items for Jordan if we proceed: send NAT/egress ranges, confirm whether you want a /29 whitelist or discrete IPs, and confirm the peering window. Once we have those, Ben/Marissa and I will lock dates in the MAP.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment: network-requirements-snippet.txt (text/plain)

-Jonas

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP: environment handoff & network items

Alex / Jordan —

Great — thanks for the quick responses and for the PDF. Summary and next steps (MAP commitments updated):
1) Peering: Confirmed window 2027-08-31 02:00-05:00 PT. Neha will run the smoke tests during the window.
2) IP allowlist: Jordan to provide NAT egress ranges; Redwood will return the /29 or five discrete IPs for host whitelisting by 2027-08-26 EOD.
3) Org & API keys: Redwood will provision an "eval" org and create scoped eval API keys. Keys will be delivered via Hub (secure link) and rotated after 14 days.
4) Legal addendum: I opened a request with our contracts team — DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/link/CW-3421-MAP. Legal expects to send the one-page addendum within 48 hours.
5) Timeline: target eval start 2027-09-06; close/decision meeting tentatively 2027-09-27. Jonas approved engineering standby and a one-time onboarding credit up to $4,000 if needed.

I've updated the HubSpot record and attached the MAP version we just shared. Please confirm Jordan's NAT ranges and we will publish the final MAP and calendar invites for the peering window.

Thanks all — excited to get this moving.
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: CW-MAP-v1.xlsx (updated), network-requirements-snippet.txt
